component.name: MSI Keyboard
MSI Keyboard
component.summary: Monitor supported MSI keyboards on Linux
Состояние поддерживаемых клавиатур MSI в Linux

description.p: MSI Keyboard shows supported devices, their connection transport, and battery state in a focused desktop interface.
USB and wireless receiver sightings are combined into one logical device, and the view refreshes automatically when hardware is connected or removed.

screenshot.caption: Device list and selected keyboard status

description.p: Prevents unsafe battery queries over direct USB, reports USB charging without a false percentage, improves window and tray rendering, enforces a single application instance, and fixes Cinnamon icon cache integration.
Improves tray controls with close-to-tray behavior and a dedicated Quit command, and adds one-command DEB installation for contributors.
Adds reliable multi-device handling, model-specific battery protocols, live tray status, and improved desktop integration.
Adds a unified device view, verified battery status, and desktop integration.
